## Glossary

**blocked**  
Task state set only by blockTask, which no tool calls.

**blockTask / unclaimTask / assignTask**  
Helpers in src/tasks with no MCP tool and no emitted event.

**claimed**  
Task state after hivemind_claim_task; its own status, owned by claimed_by.

**claimTask**  
Data call: sets claimed only where status is pending; returns null if taken or missing.

**done**  
Task state after hivemind_complete_task, or when the task vanished from its plan file.

**extractTasksFromPlan**  
The regex task extractor (same function as extractTasksWithRegex) used by plan sync.

**getPendingTasks**  
Lists claimable pending tasks, optionally for one plan.

**getTasksByPlan**  
Lists every task of a plan in any status.

**hivemind_claim_task / hivemind_start_task / hivemind_complete_task**  
MCP tools (project, taskId, agentId) that move a task and emit task:claim, task:start, task:complete.

**in_progress**  
Task state after hivemind_start_task.

**initialPlanSync**  
One-time scan that syncs every existing plan file at coordinator start.

**living documents**  
Plans never auto-complete; they stay active as context after all tasks are done.

**pending**  
Task state: unclaimed and claimable.

**plan file**  
A markdown file in ~/.claude/plans/ written in Claude's plan mode; the source of a plan's tasks.

**plan status**  
active by default; complete when its file is deleted and the watcher had seen it.

**plan-sync**  
This class: plan files in ~/.claude/plans/ synced into plan and task records by the coordinator's watcher.

**project: frontmatter**  
Plan-file frontmatter key; files naming another project are skipped.

**reconcileTasks**  
Matches extracted tasks to DB tasks by lowercase title: create new, mark missing done, update status.

**release on death**  
markAgentDead returns a dead agent's claimed and in_progress tasks to pending (agents-and-liveness).

**startPlanWatcher**  
Watches the plans directory with a debounce and syncs changed files; started by the coordinator.

**syncPlanFile**  
Syncs one plan file: create the plan if new, extract tasks, reconcile, emit plan:create or plan:sync.

**tasks**  
This class: task records, their states and the claim, start and complete workflow.

**tsk_ id**  
Task id inheriting its plan's hex plus a 3-digit sequence; subtasks as 001.1 (storage-and-primitives).

## 1. What this Warden covers

How a Claude plan file becomes a plan record with tasks in the project DB, and how agents take a task through claim, start and complete without stepping on each other.

## 2. The domain

Plan sync runs inside the coordinator: startPlanWatcher watches ~/.claude/plans/*.md with a debounce, initialPlanSync catches up on existing files at coordinator start, and syncPlanFile does one file end to end. It skips files whose `project:` frontmatter names another project, creates the plan if needed, extracts tasks with extractTasksFromPlan (the regex extractor, the same function as extractTasksWithRegex: checkboxes, numbered ## to #### headers, top-level numbered items) and hands them to reconcileTasks, which matches by lowercase title, creates new tasks (task:create) and marks tasks gone from the file done; it emits plan:create or plan:sync. Plans are living documents and never auto-complete; deleting a file marks its plan complete only if this coordinator process saw it (ARCHITECTURE.md § Plan Lifecycle). createPlan, getPlan, getActivePlans and updatePlanStatus are the record helpers for code with no plan file behind it.

Tasks move pending → claimed → in_progress → done; claim succeeds only on a pending task, and complete also works straight from claimed (ARCHITECTURE.md § Plan Lifecycle, Task States). Agents use the MCP tools hivemind_claim_task, hivemind_start_task and hivemind_complete_task (claimTaskTool/executeClaimTask, startTaskTool/executeStartTask, completeTaskTool/executeCompleteTask), which emit task:claim, task:start and task:complete; claimTask, startTask and completeTask in src/tasks are the data calls under them and emit nothing. To find work, list pending tasks with getPendingTasks or a plan's whole set with getTasksByPlan. blockTask, unclaimTask and assignTask exist in src/tasks but no MCP tool calls them and nothing emits task:block or task:unclaim, so an agent cannot block, release or reassign a task through hivemind; a dead agent's claimed and in_progress tasks return to pending through markAgentDead (agents-and-liveness).

Not here: the coordinator that hosts the watcher and the dead-agent sweep belong to agents-and-liveness; pln_ and tsk_ ids to storage-and-primitives; reading the plan:* and task:* events back to event-log; how tools are defined and served to mcp-server.

### Class `tasks`: Task records and states (pending, claimed, in_progress, blocked, done): createTask, claim/start/complete tools, blockTask/unclaimTask/assignTask helpers

**Job: move a task through its states** (Task tools vs src/tasks calls vs untooled helpers) — ARCHITECTURE.md § Plan Lifecycle (Task States)

*Said as:* "take this task so nobody else does", "mark that I've started working on it", "I'm done with the task", "give this task back or mark it blocked"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **claimTaskTool** | an agent takes a pending task (hivemind_claim_task, emits task:claim) | the task is already claimed: claim only succeeds on pending |
| **startTaskTool** | an agent begins work on its claimed task (hivemind_start_task) | the task is not yet claimed (use claimTaskTool first) |
| **completeTaskTool** | an agent finishes a claimed or started task (hivemind_complete_task) | giving work back unfinished: no tool does that |
| **claimTask** | hivemind code claims with a db handle; the data call under the tool | an agent claims (use claimTaskTool, which also emits) |
| **assignTask** | code overrides an existing claim; no tool calls it | a normal claim (use claimTask) |
| **unclaimTask** | code returns a claimed task to pending; no tool, no event | the agent died (markAgentDead (agents-and-liveness) releases it) |
| **blockTask** | code marks a task blocked; no tool, no event, reason not stored | returning it to the pool (use unclaimTask) |

**Job: find tasks to look at or work on** (getPendingTasks vs getTasksByPlan vs getTask) — ARCHITECTURE.md § Plan Lifecycle (Finding Work)

*Said as:* "what work is still up for grabs", "list every task in this plan", "look up this task by its id"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **getPendingTasks** | finding claimable work, optionally in one plan | you need tasks in every status (use getTasksByPlan) |
| **getTasksByPlan** | a plan's whole task set in any status | only claimable ones (use getPendingTasks) |
| **getTask** | one task by known id | a list (use getTasksByPlan or getPendingTasks) |

## 4. The specifics, in full

### 4a. Doc sections

Each unit is the doc section verbatim, with its headings shifted down two levels. A source line above it gives the path, the section and the doc's H1.

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#data-flow -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Data Flow (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Data Flow

##### Agent Registration
```
Claude starts → SessionStart hook
  → executeRegister() (init DB if needed, create or reconnect agent with PID)
  → executeStatus()
  → Output to Claude's context
```

##### Event Communication
```
Agent emits event → hivemind_emit MCP tool
  → ensureCoordinator() (start if needed)
  → Insert into events table
  → Other agents query via hivemind_query
```

##### Plan Sync
```
Claude enters plan mode → Creates file in ~/.claude/plans/
  → Plan watcher (in the coordinator) detects changes
  → Skips files whose `project:` frontmatter names another project
  → Extract tasks from markdown (regex)
  → Reconcile tasks with database
  → Tasks linked to plan
```

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#plan-lifecycle -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Plan Lifecycle (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Plan Lifecycle

Plans are **living documents**, not transient workflows. They persist as context even after all tasks complete.

```
~/.claude/plans/feature-auth.md          ~/.hivemind/.../hivemind.db
            │                                        │
            ▼                                        ▼
┌─────────────────────┐                  ┌─────────────────────┐
│  Plan File (md)     │  ──watcher──▶    │  Plan Record        │
│  - Context/notes    │                  │  status: active     │
│  - Task list        │                  ├─────────────────────┤
│  - Updated freely   │                  │  Tasks              │
└─────────────────────┘                  │  - pending (3)      │
                                         │  - in_progress (1)  │
                                         │  - done (5)         │
                                         └─────────────────────┘
```

##### Why Plans Don't Auto-Complete

1. **Living context** - Users update plans with notes, discoveries, new tasks
2. **Multi-session** - Plans may span multiple Claude sessions
3. **Documentation** - Plan file serves as record of decisions made

##### Finding Work

Agents find work by querying plans with pending tasks:
```
Plans with open work:
  pln_abc123 "Auth Refactor"     [3 pending, 1 in_progress, 2 done]
  pln_def456 "API Cleanup"       [1 pending, 0 in_progress, 8 done]
```

##### Task States

```
pending ──claim──▶ claimed ──start──▶ in_progress ──complete──▶ done
                     │                                   ▲
                     └──────────────complete─────────────┘
```

`claimed` is its own status. Claim only succeeds on a `pending` task. A dead agent's `claimed` and `in_progress` tasks go back to `pending`. The schema and `src/tasks/` also have `blocked` (`blockTask`) and `unclaimTask`, but no MCP tool calls them. When a task disappears from its plan file, reconciliation marks it `done`.

```
```

##### Plan Cleanup

Plans can be:
- **Deleted** - Remove the `.md` file; the watcher marks the plan "complete" (only for files it has seen since the coordinator started)
- **Archived** - Keep file but move out of `~/.claude/plans/`
- **Left active** - Fine to keep plans with all tasks done as documentation

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#key-design-decisions -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Key Design Decisions (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Key Design Decisions

1. **PID-based lifecycle locally, leases over the network** - Locally no heartbeats are needed: agents live as long as their process. In network mode each tool call renews the agent's lease.

2. **Coordinator singleton** - One per project, runs forever, minimal overhead.

3. **Session ID lookup** - MCP tools can find agent by Claude's session ID.

4. **Grace period** - New agents get 1 minute before PID checking kicks in (local mode).

5. **Event-based communication** - Agents don't talk directly; they emit/query events.

6. **Plans as living docs** - Plans don't auto-complete; they persist as context. Find work by querying plans with pending tasks.

- **getActivePlans** `src/plans/getActivePlans.ts#getActivePlans` [primitive] list all plans whose status is active Use: const plans = getActivePlans(db);
- **getPlan** `src/plans/getPlan.ts#getPlan` [primitive] fetch one plan by id, or null if missing Use: const plan = getPlan(db, planId);
- **initialPlanSync** `src/watcher/planWatcher.ts#initialPlanSync` [primitive] scan existing plan files in ~/.claude/plans/ and sync each into the project Use: await initialPlanSync(project);
- **reconcileTasks** `src/llm/reconcileTasks.ts#reconcileTasks` [primitive] sync a plan's tasks in the DB with tasks extracted from its file Use: reconcileTasks(db, planId, extractTasksFromPlan(markdown));
- **startPlanWatcher** `src/watcher/planWatcher.ts#startPlanWatcher` [primitive] watch the Claude plans directory and sync plan files as they change Use: startPlanWatcher({ project, ... });
- **syncPlanFile** `src/watcher/planWatcher.ts#syncPlanFile` [primitive] sync one plan file into the project's plan and task records Use: const r = await syncPlanFile(project, filename);
- **updatePlanStatus** `src/plans/updatePlanStatus.ts#updatePlanStatus` [primitive] change a plan's status Use: updatePlanStatus(db, planId, status);

#### Class `tasks`
- **assignTask** `src/tasks/assignTask.ts#assignTask` [primitive] force-assign a task to a given agent even if another agent already claimed it Use: assignTask(db, taskId, agentId)
- **blockTask** `src/tasks/blockTask.ts#blockTask` [primitive] mark a claimed or in-progress task blocked (the reason argument is accepted but not stored) Use: blockTask(db, taskId, reason?)
- **claimTask** `src/tasks/claimTask.ts#claimTask` [primitive] claim a pending task for an agent, failing if it is already claimed or missing Use: claimTask(db, taskId, agentId) // Task | null
- **claimTaskTool** `src/mcp/tools/tasks.ts#claimTaskTool` [primitive] define the hivemind_claim_task tool that marks a task as owned by this agent Use: MCP tool name: hivemind_claim_task
- **completeTask** `src/tasks/completeTask.ts#completeTask` [primitive] mark a task complete and record its outcome Use: completeTask(db, taskId, outcome?)
- **completeTaskTool** `src/mcp/tools/tasks.ts#completeTaskTool` [primitive] define the hivemind_complete_task tool that marks a task done Use: MCP tool name: hivemind_complete_task
- **createTask** `src/tasks/createTask.ts#createTask` [primitive] create a new task inside a plan Use: createTask(db, { plan_id, ... }) // returns Task
- **executeClaimTask** `src/mcp/tools/tasks.ts#executeClaimTask` [primitive] claim a pending task for the calling agent Use: executeClaimTask({ project, taskId, agentId })
- **executeCompleteTask** `src/mcp/tools/tasks.ts#executeCompleteTask` [primitive] mark a task completed for the calling agent Use: executeCompleteTask({ project, taskId, agentId })
- **executeStartTask** `src/mcp/tools/tasks.ts#executeStartTask` [primitive] mark a claimed task as in progress Use: executeStartTask({ project, taskId, agentId })
- **getPendingTasks** `src/tasks/getPendingTasks.ts#getPendingTasks` [primitive] list unclaimed pending tasks, optionally limited to one plan Use: getPendingTasks(db, planId?) // Task[]
- **getTask** `src/tasks/getTask.ts#getTask` [primitive] look up a single task by its id Use: getTask(db, taskId) // Task | null
- **getTasksByPlan** `src/tasks/getTasksByPlan.ts#getTasksByPlan` [primitive] list all tasks belonging to a plan, in any status Use: getTasksByPlan(db, planId) // Task[]
- **startTask** `src/tasks/startTask.ts#startTask` [primitive] mark a claimed task as in progress Use: startTask(db, taskId) // boolean
- **startTaskTool** `src/mcp/tools/tasks.ts#startTaskTool` [primitive] define the hivemind_start_task tool that marks a claimed task in progress Use: MCP tool name: hivemind_start_task
- **unclaimTask** `src/tasks/unclaimTask.ts#unclaimTask` [primitive] release a claimed task back to pending and clear its claimant Use: unclaimTask(db, taskId) // boolean
